notes: Ruling needed (rule 6, rule 11): «فلقيته فساءلته» has Aisha meet a man who is named only later as «ابن عمرو» ("إن ابن عمرو قد قدم فالقه"); he is read as the source of the saying (the «فيما ذكر» saying), but he also appears inside the scene, and the text has Urwa meet him too («الحديث الذي ذكره لك»). The ruling decides whether he is a link
«يا ابن أختي» is Aisha's address to Urwa, not a name
